div.head: EGu 9.1
div.ab: Gyf man wealdan mæge, ne dyde man næfre on Sunnandæges freolse ænige forwyrhtne, ac wylde ⁊ healde, þæt se freolsdæg agan sy.
Gif man wealdan mage, ne dyde man næfre on Sunnandæges freolse ænigne forwyrhtne, ac wylde ⁊ healde, þæt se freolsdæg agan sy.
Si fieri possit, numquam occidatur aliquis in festo dominice diei, quidquid peccauerit; sed capiatur et seruetur, donec festus dies transierit.
Gif man wealdan mage, ne dyde man næfre on Sunnandæges freolse ænige forwyrhtne, ac wylde ⁊ healde, þæt se freolsdæg agan sy.
If it can be so contrived, no capital offender shall ever be put to death during the feast of Sunday, but he shall be arrested and kept in custody until the festival is over.
Wenn einzurichten möglich ist, richte man niemals in der Sonntagsfeier irgend welchen Verurtheilten hin, sondern bewältige und halte [ihn fest, bis] dass der Feiertag vergangen ist.
If it can be arranged, let no condemned man ever be executed during the Sunday feast, but let him be overpowered and held [until] the feast-day is past.
